classifications.item_title: Book on Truth in the Age of A.I. Contains Quotes Made Up by A.I.

kb_matches.rationale: AI fabricated quotes that were presented as real in a published nonfiction book, a direct example of hallucination/confabulation causing real-world harm.
Made-up or misattributed quotes in a published book constitute AI-generated misinformation that reached an audience at scale.
Author over-relied on AI-generated content without sufficient independent verification, illustrating automation bias.

classifications.evidence_quote: he had included numerous made-up or misattributed quotes concocted by A.I.
classifications.recommended_action: Update A1 (Hallucination) with this as a concrete real-world case study where AI-fabricated quotes were published in a nonfiction book, and note the downstream E3 misinformation risk.

classifications.item_title: Bay Area mom out thousands after scammers use AI to mimic daughter's voice in fake kidnapping

kb_matches.rationale: Scammers used AI to clone a person's voice for impersonation in a fraudulent kidnapping scheme, directly matching the deepfakes and synthetic media fraud entry.

classifications.evidence_quote: scammers used artificial intelligence to mimic her daughter's voice in what authorities describe as a growing type of fraud
classifications.recommended_action: Update C4 (Deepfakes & Synthetic Media Fraud) to explicitly include AI voice cloning used in virtual kidnapping and phone-based financial fraud as a documented and growing attack vector.
